---
output: word_document
params:
  helpers: ""
  figdir: ""
  dec: "."
  lta_res: NA
  console_out: NA
  ai_summary: ""
  notes: NA
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
source(params$helpers)
w_init(params$dec, params$figdir)
nt <- params$notes
res <- params$lta_res
if (identical(res, NA)) res <- NULL
```

```{r body, results='asis'}
w_cover(nt, "Latent Trait (IRT) Analysis Report")
w_notes(nt, c("objectives"))

w_h("Method", 1)
w_user(if (w_has(nt, "method")) nt$method else method_text("lta", list(res = res)))

w_h("Results", 1)
if (is.null(res)) {
  w_p("No LTA / IRT results are available.")
} else {
  cfs <- tryCatch(coef(res, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(cfs$items)) {
    w_h("Item Parameters", 2)
    it <- as.data.frame(cfs$items); it <- data.frame(Item = rownames(it), it, check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
    w_table(it, "Item parameters of the estimated IRT model", digits = 3,
            note = "a = discrimination; b = difficulty or threshold; g and u = lower and upper asymptotes.")
  }
  w_h("Item Characteristic Curves", 2)
  w_figure(function() print(plot(res, type = "trace")), "Trace lines of the items", width = 6.5, height = 5)
  w_h("Item Information", 2)
  w_figure(function() print(plot(res, type = "info")), "Item information curves", width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
}

w_notes(nt, c("results"))
w_ai(params$ai_summary)
w_console(params$console_out)
w_refs()
```
